# Copilot Instructions

This repository stores reusable personal AI-agent skills.

- Use `AGENTS.md` as the shared instruction source.
- Treat `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` as the canonical source for each skill.
- Keep agent-specific config files thin and avoid duplicating full skill bodies.
- When changing a skill, validate it with the `skill-creator` validator documented in `AGENTS.md`.
